name: How long does a bathroom wall tile installation project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom wall tile installation project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A typical tub-surround or walk-in shower wall tile installation takes about 3 to 5 business days to complete. The process involves removing old wall coverings, fixing framing issues, hanging waterproof backer board, laying tile, and letting thin-set cure for at least 24 hours. Grouting, detail caulking along inside corners, and sealing natural stone or cement grout add another day or two. Timelines can extend if custom niches, intricate mosaic patterns, or plumbing fixture relocations are part of the scope.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most shower or bathroom wall tiling projects take 3 to 5 business days, accounting for demo, backer board prep, setting tile, curing, and grouting.
